label: risky
what: anyone can join any team, then read its documents
description: A Supabase migration that adds teams, team members and team documents. Team documents can be read by members of that team, which is checked properly. But any signed-in person may add themselves to the members table of any team.
title: add teams, members and team documents
auditNote: Still risky: checked in the sandbox, Bob can add himself to Alice's team. But the team_members read rule selects from itself, so reading it or the documents fails with infinite recursion, for everyone. No read of Alice's data works as written, and team_documents has no owner column, so the seeder never fills it. Marked not provable before any Lucid run.
